author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: ClickFix campaigns are evolving, with attackers increasingly targeting macOS users and deploying more advanced infostealers, according to Sophos researchers. ClickFix is a growing social engineering technique that tricks users into manually executing malicious commands, bypassing traditional protections. title: From Windows to macOS: ClickFix attacks shift tactics with ChatGPT-based lures
